description: Listed companies in a GICS-aligned sector, industry group, industry or sub-industry (worldgdp.org classification from filed activity codes: SEC SIC codes for US listings, TSE 33 sectors for Japan): name, ticker, exchange, market cap (USD m, US listings), latest weekly price and currency, 3-month weekly closes. Pair with get_sectors to set survey readings next to the stocks they affect.
name: get_companies
